sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def eye_pos(frame):
    L=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if L[rr][cc]=='S']
    if not sc: return None
    rs=sorted(set(x[0] for x in sc)); cs=sorted(set(x[1] for x in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs),min(left),max(right))

seq=['DOWN','DOWN','RIGHT','RIGHT']
for a in seq:
    r=action([a], intent='explore')
    res=last_action_result
    p=eye_pos(current_frame)
    print(a,"-> step",current_frame.step,"eyes",p,
          "| board_changed",res.get('board_changed'),"no_impact",res.get('no_impact'),
          "level_completed",res.get('level_completed'),"done",res.get('done'))
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete'):
        print("TERMINAL after",a); break
    if res.get('no_impact'):
        print("NO IMPACT after",a); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def eye_pos(frame):
    L=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sc=[(rr,cc) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if L[rr][cc]=='S']
    if not sc: return None
    rs=sorted(set(x[0] for x in sc)); cs=sorted(set(x[1] for x in sc))
    left=[c for c in cs if c<32]; right=[c for c in cs if c>=32]
    return (min(rs),min(left),max(right))
